scripts.local:owner-auth: npm ci && npm ci --prefix ../web && npm --prefix ../web run build && wrangler d1 migrations apply DB --local --config wrangler.owner-e2e.runtime.jsonc && wrangler dev --local --config wrangler.owner-e2e.runtime.jsonc --ip 127.0.0.1 --var JWT_SECRET:local-only-synthetic-secret-never-use-remotely-0000000000
